pairs.question: Damnamus veteres?
pairs.answer: Minime; sed post priorum studia in domo Domini quod possumus laboramus.
pairs.derivation: Jerome poses and answers his own question. Dropped the preceding framing exclamation 'Quid igitur?' (the rhetorical lead-in 'What then?') and kept the operative interrogative 'Damnamus veteres?'. Answer ends at the first full stop ('...laboramus.'); the next sentence ('Illi interpretati sunt ante adventum Christi...') turns to elaborating on the difference between the old translators and himself, so it is excluded.

pairs.question: Ubi scriptum est?
pairs.answer: Septuaginta non habent, apocrifa nescit Ecclesia; ad Hebraeos igitur revertendum est, unde et Dominus loquitur et discipuli exempla praesumunt.
pairs.derivation: Having stated 'Utique scriptum est quod Salvator scriptum esse testatur', Jerome opens the next paragraph by asking and answering 'Ubi scriptum est?'. The answer is the single sentence ending at the first full stop ('...exempla praesumunt.'); what follows ('Haec pace veterum loquar...') turns from answering to addressing his detractors, so it is cut.

pairs.locus: Hieronymus, Prologus in epistulis Pauli apostoli
pairs.question: Quare post Evangelia, quae supplementum Legis sunt et in quibus nobis exempla et praecepta vivendi plenissime digesta sunt, voluerit Apostolus has epistulas ad singulas ecclesias destinare?
pairs.answer: Hac autem causa factum videtur, ut scilicet initia nascentis Ecclesiae novis causis existentibus praemuniret, ut et praesentia atque orientia resecaret vitia et post futuras excluderet quaestiones, exemplo prophetarum qui post editam legem Mosi, in qua omnia Dei mandata legebantur, nihilominus tamen doctrina sua rediviva semper populi conpressere peccata et propter exemplum libris ad nostram etiam memoriam transmiserunt.
pairs.derivation: Jerome poses the question and answers it himself. Dropped the asking-narration framing 'Primum quaeritur' ('first it is asked'); the remaining words are verbatim and in source order, with the now-first word capitalized ('quare' -> 'Quare') and terminal punctuation normalized to '?'. The answer is the single sentence beginning 'Hac autem causa factum videtur...' and ending at the first full stop ('...transmiserunt.'); the following sentence ('Deinde quaeritur cur non amplius...') begins a new question, so it is excluded.
